source.note: One bounded official API extraction after Overpass capacity/timeouts. Normalized to the same element shape accepted by the importer; not claimed to be an Overpass response. Element timestamps are edit dates, not survey dates. Snapshot timestamp not supplied. Raw source retained compressed.
source.redaction: Contributor user and uid attributes removed from the public raw XML. Geodata, feature tags, element versions and edit timestamps retained. Unmodified response remains only in the local temporary directory.

imageCheck.method: North-up overlay visually inspected against both retained official imagery crops; roof displacement/date differences remain. Colors are authored, not sampled from the photographs.
